UC-1100.note: Row of a tool's step named by the tool: an MCP tool by its server's readable name and the tool's name made readable ("Used Indian Kanoon: search judgments."), any other tool the room doesn't know by its own name made readable ("Used todo write."). Replaces "Did one other thing." for a step that has a tool's name.

UC-1101.note: Row of such a step that failed or was stopped. Replaces "Tried one other thing." for a step that has a tool's name.

UC-1102.note: Row of a skill step, the skill's name made readable ("Used the legal drafting skill."; Claude's Skill tool, ChatGPT's read of SKILL.md). Replaces "Read Clauseo's drafting guide." and "Read a guide.".

UC-1103.note: Row of such a skill step that failed or was stopped. Replaces "Tried to read Clauseo's drafting guide." and "Tried to read a guide.".

UC-1104.note: Row of a command with the agent's own words for it (Claude's Bash description, ChatGPT's justification), first letter lower ("Ran: count the pages of the plaint."). Replaces the bare words ("Count the pages of the plaint.").

UC-1105.note: Row of such a command that failed or was stopped. Replaces "Tried: {title}." for a command.

UC-1106.note: Row of a helper step with no task given (Claude's Agent untitled, ChatGPT's spawn with no prompt). Replaces "Did one other thing.".

UC-1107.note: Row of such a helper step that failed or was stopped. Replaces "Tried one other thing.".

UC-1108.note: Row of a chained command (&&, ;, |), counted. Was "Ran {n} tasks." (UTC-32, which is now the folded line's "ran {n} commands").

UC-1109.note: Part of the folded line's one sentence, joined with commas ("Read 1 paper, used the legal drafting skill."): one skill, by its name. Replaces part of "Did {n} other things.".

UC-1110.note: Part of the folded line's one sentence: one skill that names none.

UC-1111.note: Part of the folded line's one sentence: one helper asked. Replaces part of "Did {n} other things.".

UC-1112.note: Part of the folded line's one sentence: helpers asked, counted.

UC-1113.note: Part of the folded line's one sentence for a thinking step beside others; alone the line says "Planned the work." (UTC-33).

UC-1114.note: Part of the folded line's one sentence for a step nothing names, said once beside any named tools. Replaces "Did {n} other things." for such steps.
